finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs, both from the bump.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | Options renamed `retries` to `retryCount` | Accept both |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag is now `undefined`, not `false` | Treat unset as off |

The 8 warnings left are real deprecations, not errors. `crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js` is the one to fix next.
